references.text: Abidan, son of Gideoni, is again mentioned as the leader of the tribe of Benjamin in the camp arrangement.
Abidan, son of Gideoni, brought his offering as the prince of the children of Benjamin on the ninth day at the dedication of the tabernacle.
Abidan, son of Gideoni, led the army of the children of Benjamin when the Israelites broke camp from Sinai.
Benjamin was Jacob's youngest son, and here the origin of the tribe is mentioned.
The sons of Benjamin who came to Egypt are listed, showing the genealogy of the tribe.
